title: 5" Display Camera Baby Monitor with Temperature Sensor US$56.95 (~$87.21) Delivered @ MBOSS Official Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: 5" Display Camera Baby Monitor with Temperature Sensor US$56.95 (~$87.21) Delivered @ MBOSS Official Store AliExpress

[dynaflow] baby to Marge…..baby to Marge….waaah waaah
[Elusive8985] Do these come with the added bonus of livestreaming to the world?
[Clear] Of course not. There's no wifi connectivity and they don't connect to the internet.
[Elusive8985] Sorry, humour is hard on the internet, was a poor reference to the indoor cameras from china that were livestreaming to the world, without owners knowledge.
[Namidairo] If you really want to know, it looks like a frequency hopping thing with 20 channels on 2.4ghz, GFSK modulation.
Presumably the RF board is doing the encryption in-line (I couldn't make out the part numbers), and it's implemented in a sane way. (If we should be so lucky)
[jmc787] Nah these ones only livestream to the CCP
[hexedhavoc] I got this same model for around $60aud not too long ago, so id recommend waiting (seen it several times for around 65 during the last sales too)
[1jwoz] "an inbuilt battery providing 22 hours of runtime, allowing you to use it unplugged or maintain operation during a power outage."
Real handy when the camera is powered via 240v
[Clear] Nothing a power bank won't solve. Every OzBargainer should have plenty with all the cheap deals.
[Aguynamedlance] I've taken the Tweety cam to a wedding and ran it off a power bank because its power cable has a USB on the wall end.
[codyy] I have 2 of these, the default is quite zoomed in but they’re good for the money. The white noise volume is also quite loud on the lowest setting if you’re intending on using it.
Monitor has great battery life and range.
[Oldmate88] Agreed. The white noise is disappointing.
My only other complaints are you can only hear from 1 camera at a time and you can't talk & listen at the same time.
Othe than that, they're great
[RedTaco] could anyone confirm if this camera would connect to a tweetycam branded monitor?
[ordinarygreenbottle] Can confirm yes, mine did! I originally bought Tweetycam, before I made 3 seperate orders (over the span of 3 years) for additional non-branded cameras, and all worked great.
Anyone still buying official Tweetycam at their prices is nuts.
[DragoBoyz] Bought 2 years ago for around $100 and couldnt recommend more. Great monitor we only use it for sound and vision couldn't care less about any of the other features other monitors have.
[chillybags] We got the updated v2 version with the larger screen which looks a bit more modern which is nice. Main benefit is the screen just plugs into usb c so can easily charge that around the house with various chargers we have setup depending on what/where we are doing things.
[ikarntspel] We use the newer version. Search "SM70" in aliexpress. Its around ~$160 for monitor and 2 cams. This one is the older SM50 version. Newer version has a larger screen and 1080p.
[Rochie] For anyone needing just the monitor they are on separate listings for much cheaper if that's all you are after.
Unfortunately this is out 3rd monitor due to kids dropping it and the screne breaking.
[Chippy47] Can also recommend this kit, bought it a couple years ago and has been perfect.
